candidates.A: published-grid production proxy (benchmark only; mixes model and market)
candidates.C: independent research model team_form_poisson_v1 (value shortlist; uses no odds)
candidates.C2: candidate: C with a draw and low-score correction (rho, delta) fitted walk-forward on C's own earlier forecasts and their scores, pooled across leagues (research_low_score.py; uses no odds)
candidates.C3: candidate: C with historical Understat match xG in the team form, from matches before the fold origin only (understat_history.py; five big leagues, C elsewhere; uses no odds)
candidates.C5: candidate: C with its home/away split sharpened by a calibration slope fitted walk-forward on C's own earlier forecasts of decided matches, draw held, pooled across leagues (research_sharpen.py; uses no odds)
candidates.C6: candidate: C2's draw and low-score corrected grid with its home/away split sharpened by a slope fitted walk-forward on C2's own earlier forecasts of decided matches, C2's draw held, pooled across leagues (research_low_score_sharpen.py; uses no odds)
candidates.D: cagey tier: M corrected toward narrow margins (production correction model)
candidates.M: market reference: margin-free fit to the period bookmaker (Pinnacle, Bet365 on the holdout)

calibration_tolerance.name: slopes-0.90-1.10-bands-30-5pp-bonferroni-v2

replaces.name: slopes-0.90-1.10-bands-30-5pp-v1
replaces.reason: Replaced before any holdout scoring: v1 failed a band on any gap above 5 points, however few matches, so it failed even the market reference M on noise.
replaces.rule: Same slopes; a band failed whenever it was more than 5 percentage points from its observed rate (at least 30 matches), with no allowance for sample size.

calibration_tolerance.rule: Logistic calibration slope (logit P(outcome) = a + b logit(p), fitted per outcome) of the home and of the away probability both between 0.90 and 1.10 inclusive, and no failing outcome probability band (home, draw and away, tenths of probability, at least 30 matches). A band fails only if it is more than 5 percentage points from its observed rate AND the gap is statistically clear: |gap| / sqrt(p(1-p)/n) above the two-sided normal quantile for 0.05 divided by the number of bands checked (Bonferroni; about 3.0 for 20 bands), p = the band's mean forecast.

periods.development: 1 Aug 2022 - 30 Jun 2025, Pinnacle pre-match prices. Build and choose candidates here.
periods.holdout: 16 Jan - 10 Oct 2026, Eredivisie, Primeira Liga and Super Lig only (646 matches, 25 weeks), Bet365 pre-match prices with the margin removed. No earlier benchmark or live report scored these results. Locked: one declared candidate per run, once per candidate and once per frozen setup.
periods.retrospective: Every other match from 16 Jan 2026, Bet365. The five big leagues to 13 Oct 2026 were scored by the earlier benchmark (historical_benchmark_config.json), and every league from 11 Oct 2026 by the live performance reports. Diagnostics only, never release evidence.
periods.validation: 1 Jul 2025 - 15 Jan 2026, Pinnacle pre-match prices. Already inspected by earlier diagnostics; the cagey correction is out-of-sample here.
periods.warm_up: 2021/22 is training history only; scoring starts 1 Aug 2022.

config.release_rule: A candidate is scored on the holdout once, against a written declaration. It must beat its baseline with the 95% week-resampled interval clear of zero, and must beat the market reference by more than the measured Bet365-Pinnacle gap to count as beating the market. Before release it must pass a parity test (harness and live pipeline give identical probabilities) and a replay over the saved live forecasts. There is no forward waiting for backtestable changes. Changes reach production only through a reviewed PR, with monitoring and a rollback trigger afterwards.

declaration.notes: Scored once with evaluation_harness.py --declaration. Passing requires C - C6 log loss on AH all lines with the week-resampled 95% interval clear of zero, the sample minimum, and calibration v2 on C6's holdout forecasts. Draw-sensitive and 1X2 are reported, not gating. Against M, C6 counts as beating the market only if it beats it by more than the measured Bet365-Pinnacle gap.

holdout_verdict.next_steps: Passing the holdout is necessary, not sufficient: parity test and live replay follow, then a reviewed PR.

notes: Headline means use the common cohort: fixtures where C, C2, C3, C5, C6, M, D and A are all available (C3 and C5 exist wherever C does, C6 wherever C2 does).
Positive mean_gain means the first-named candidate has the lower log loss than the second.
Intervals resample whole calendar weeks across all leagues.
The cagey correction was trained on seasons through 2024/25; D is in-sample in development.
Retrospective results were already scored elsewhere; they are diagnostics, never release evidence.
Historical prices are pre-match snapshots without timestamps; returns are not claimed.
No automatic promotion: every production change goes through a reviewed PR.
